name: two-step-sign-in
title: Two-step sign-in
description: In isometric ink: a sign-in screen floating over a construction grid asks for a code, the phone hops as the text lands, the code pops off as a lit chip and is tossed into the input, the screen takes the hit, and the user is in. Objects move as solids; leans with the pointer; in your theme.

useCases: SaaS security and login feature sections
